conflicts.ours: SKO Zc 1 carries two lines, na-tu-*301-ne and qa-ki-ti
conflicts.theirs: RILA Supplement 1 splits the text across SKO Zc 1 and SKO Zc 2
conflicts.note: Our single SKO Zc 1 record may already hold what RILA Supplement 1 splits in two. That needs autopsy of the plates, which RILA Supplement 1 does not contain. Recorded, not resolved.

rila.support: painted inscription on a clay vessel, fragment of a chalice; the same object as SKO Zc 1
rila.editio_princeps: Perna, Kanta and Tyree 2005, in Studi in onore di Enrica Fiandra, Studi Egei e Vicinorientali 1, De Boccard, pages 321 to 333, figure 10a-b. The same article is the editio princeps of both SKO Zc 1 and SKO Zc 2.
rila.source: RILA Supplement 1 Concordance museographique and facsimile lemma
rila.note: Reading UNCERTAIN and not entered. The RILA Supplement 1 Index des signes shows a shape like ]...-67-37[ , that is ...-ki-ti, and the two candidates qa-ki-ti[ and de-ki-ti[ cannot be separated from the plain-text extraction. We do not hold the editio princeps.

text_missing_reason: No reading is entered for SKO Zc 2. RILA Supplement 1 (Del Freo and Zurbach 2024) lists the object, and this site holds no drawing or photograph to read it from. The gap is in our sources, not on the object.
